title: HalaCG Music
description: A Fabric content mod featuring custom music discs, new blocks and ores, biome integration, and expanded world generation. Music © HalaCG.
body:
🎵 HalaMusic — Ruby Tools, Armor & Custom Music Discs Inspired by HalaCG

[![Minecraft 1.20.4](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.4-brightgreen.svg)](https://www.minecraft.net/)
[![Fabric Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Fabric-blue.svg)](https://fabricmc.net/)
[![Java 21](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange.svg)](https://adoptium.net/)
[![Music © HalaCG](https://img.shields.io/badge/Music%20License-%C2%A9%20HalaCG-purple.svg)](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFbfFv3bjWctmO2IQoHLiHg)

HalaMusic is a Fabric content mod that expands Minecraft with ruby-based equipment, custom blocks, world generation, biomes, dimensions, and fully functional music discs featuring tracks inspired by the artist HalaCG.

Mine new ores, craft powerful tools, explore additional blocks and world features, discover custom environments, and collect unique discs to play inside your Minecraft world.

💎 Features

🔹 Ruby Ore Generation

Ruby ore generates across multiple dimensions depending on configuration:

Overworld ruby ore

Nether ruby ore

End ruby ore

Deepslate variants

Smelt Raw Rubies → Rubies

Ruby building blocks, including:

Blocks

Slabs & stairs

Fences

Trapdoors & doors

🔹 Custom Crafting Station

Gem Polishing Station
A custom workbench used for ruby crafting and progression

🌳 Blocks, Trees & World Generation

Chestnut Trees that generate naturally

Full Chestnut wood set, including:

Logs & stripped logs

Planks

Leaves

Designed to blend seamlessly with vanilla terrain and progression

🌍 Biomes & Dimensions

Custom biome integration using TerraBlender

Includes a custom dimension, accessible through a custom portal

World generation focused on exploration and atmosphere

🔹 Custom Music Discs

Collect several music discs inspired by songs created by HalaCG, including:

Hala

Brawl

Each disc plays a unique track when inserted into a jukebox.

⚠️ Copyright Notice

All music referenced in this mod is owned and copyrighted by HalaCG.
This mod does not distribute full music tracks — only metadata and identifiers for in-game discs.

Support the original artist:

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFbfFv3bjWctmO2IQoHLiHg

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/0Tbadays3Z2K3BxmvjL34J

📦 Installation

Required:

Fabric Loader (latest)

Fabric API

TerraBlender

Steps:

Install Fabric Loader

Install Fabric API

Download the latest HalaMusic version

Place the .jar into your mods folder

Launch the game

📁 Compatibility

Works on Minecraft 1.20.4

Designed for Fabric

Compatible with most worldgen and music-related mods

Safe to add to existing worlds

Removal may cause missing block/item issues (backup recommended)
